text.text:
This department store is praised for its wide selection of products, including clothing, accessories, and home goods, with many options across various price ranges. Customers also highlight the spacious, clean, and well-organized layout, along with the friendly and attentive staff.


Some reviews mention the staff can be unprofessional.
